buildIntro: Wardrobes, alcove units, cupboards and garden-office fit-outs. Each piece is made for one room and fitted to its walls.

services.title: Fitted wardrobes
services.description: Floor to ceiling, fitted into alcoves and bays, with the inside planned around what you actually own.
services.imageAlt: Two unpainted MDF wardrobes with panelled doors either side of a bay window

services.title: Garden office fit-outs
services.description: Desks, shelving and cupboards built in, so the room works from day one.
services.imageAlt: Garden office with built-in shelving, low cupboards and a long worktop

services.title: Alcoves, pantries and cupboards
services.description: Storage built into the awkward spaces, with shelves set where you need them.
services.imageAlt: Tall pantry cupboard with adjustable shelves and tray dividers

processHeading: Nothing gets cut until you've seen it.
processImageAlt: SketchUp drawing of a four-section wardrobe with shelves, hanging space and dimension lines
processCaption: Wardrobe drawn in SketchUp: 2160 mm wide, 2150 mm high.

steps.title: Survey
steps.description: I visit, measure every wall and talk through how you'll use the space.

steps.title: Draw
steps.description: You get a 3D drawing with real measurements. We adjust it until it's right, then you sign it off.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Every panel is cut to that drawing, in 18 mm board throughout, backs included.

steps.title: Fit
steps.description: I fit it on site, scribed to your walls, floor and ceiling, and leave the room clean.

appHeading: I also build software for carpenters.
appBody: CabinetOS turns a cabinet design into a parts list, a cut list and board layouts, so less material ends up in the skip.
appImageAlt: CabinetOS screen showing cabinet parts laid out on a 2440 by 1220 mm sheet
quoteBody: Send a few details and I'll reply within 24 hours to arrange a visit. Quotes are free.
formNote: I'll only use your details to reply about this job.
